title: CMDDR Statement Assessment
description: The authority actually exercised in a single passage of a document (Table 2), discerned by prudential application to the text. Overrides the genre default at its locus; may never exceed the genre ceiling.

id.description: Locus id: '{document.id}#{section}' (e.g. 'mag:john-paul-ii/evangelium-vitae-1995#62'), or '{document.id}#*' for a document-wide assessment.

section.description: Citation unit as the document numbers it (paragraph, canon, chapter+n). Use '*' for a document-wide assessment. String so ranges ('57-66') and non-numeric units ('can.9') are expressible.

topic.description: Short editorial summary of what is taught at this locus.

object.description: Set if and only if intent = 'definitive'.

reformability.description: Derived: irreformable iff intent = 'definitive'. May be omitted and computed.

allOf.description: object is present iff intent is definitive
non-definitive assent must be religiosum-obsequium or prudential
definitive assent must be a faith-tier
reformability is derived from intent (definitive => irreformable; non-definitive => reformable)
extraordinary register is a solemn definition: it requires definitive intent and a justifying, non-empty provenance note and cannot be draft
